result.finding: Assessed 6 CWE rules in Concurrency & Synchronization: 0 FOUND, 6 NOT_FOUND
evidence: Reviewed singleton/lifetime registrations, shared mutable state, list operations, sequence allocation, and synchronization primitives in both application implementations.

Memory verified: eShopLegacyMVCSolution/src/eShopLegacyMVC/Modules/ApplicationModule.cs:18-22 registers CatalogServiceMock as SingleInstance; Services/CatalogServiceMock.cs:12-16 initializes a shared List and lines 19-66 read/update/add/remove without synchronization. The eShopPorted counterparts contain the same pattern. Legacy checked-in UseMockData is false; eShopPorted UseMockData is true.

The unsynchronized singleton is a confirmed concurrency defect, but no additional unauthorized access, privilege-boundary crossing, sensitive-data disclosure, or other qualifying security exploit was established. Duplicate IDs, lost updates, and collection exceptions alone do not meet this security-only assessment threshold; availability-only impact is excluded. Thus NOT_FOUND means no qualifying exploitable security vulnerability, not absence of the concurrency pattern.
CatalogItemHiLoGenerator.GetNextSequenceValue protects its mutable sequence state with lock(sequenceLock). Database catalog services are registered per lifetime scope.
Static review only; no concurrent-request execution, race instrumentation, deployment topology inspection, or database transaction isolation testing.
Execution duration was not measured. Timestamp records overall assessment completion.

values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

values.name: Improper Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

values.name: Improper Locking
values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.

values.name: Missing Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization
values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.
